item.dc:creator: Rachel Jackson

item.title: Phillip Island business operators prepare for MotoGP's final lap
item.description: As the countdown to the final MotoGP at Victoria's Phillip Island begins, business owners and the tourism board are calling for support to develop ideas to attract tourists. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Madeleine Stuchbery

item.title: Smith monitored for concussion after hit to helmet while batting
item.description: Australia will continue to test Steve Smith for a delayed concussion, after the vice-captain's blow to the head added further questions to the side for the second Test. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Blakey closes in on North move, Lion requests late trade to Bombers
item.description: North Melbourne moves closer to securing the signature of wantaway Sydney star Nick Blakey on the penultimate day of AFL trade period. Follow the live coverage. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Dean Bilton and Chris De Silva

item.title: Dubai-bound Emirates flight forced to turn back to Adelaide Airport
item.description: The plane took off from Adelaide Airport at 10:35pm on Monday but pilots were forced to turn around before reaching the West Australian border. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Matthew Ward Agius

item.title: Live: Oil prices on the rise as energy supply concerns continue
item.description: Brent crude approached $US107 overnight, while the local share market has a mixed lead from Wall Street. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephanie Chalmers and Alex Turner-Cohen

item.title: Qantas flight grounded after bedbug outbreak
item.description: The flight from Italy to Australia was cancelled after passengers on the plane's previous journey complained of bug bites. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Rain turns dry paddocks into bumper crops after years of drought
item.description: Twelve months ago, many SA farmers were in drought, entering their fourth year without a crop and having to destock cattle to keep cashflow coming. This harvest is different after above-average rain. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Eliza Berlage and Amelia Walters

item.title: Actress Selma Blair arrested over alleged in-flight assault
item.description: Actress Selma Blair is accused of attacking and injuring two flight attendants on a flight from Los Angeles to New York. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Hundreds of French supermarkets' fridges hacked in large-scale attack
item.description: Several major food retailers in France are targeted by hackers who raised fridge temperatures to 50 degrees Celsius, causing fires and spoiling food. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Tesla releases plans for Australia's largest EV charging hub
item.description: The tech giant reveals plans to build a $3.5 million, 37-car charging station on a vacant 1,300-square-metre lot in Albury about 2.5 kilometres from the Hume Highway. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Philippe Perez

item.title: Oil company wins tenders in Channel Country with supply to stay in Australia
item.description: An Australian oil boss says any fossil fuels taken from a new location in Queensland's Channel Country will stay in Australia, but it could take years before oil or gas flows. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Crispian Yeomans

item.title: Riyadh airport stays closed as Saudis probe failures in deadly attack
item.description: Saudi officials investigate how its air defences failed to intercept deadly attacks launched by the Houthis. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Cyclist who ditched Australia withdrawn from world champs over allegations
item.description: British track cyclist Matthew Richardson, who defected from Australian cycling at the end of the Paris Games, has been withdrawn from this week's UCI Track World Championships in Shanghai. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: EDs 'not adequately equipped' for aging population, report says
item.description: The nation's peak body for emergency doctors has warned that long emergency department waits are common because of surging demand driven by Australia's aging population. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Cason Ho

item.title: Delhi a fortress as 'cockroach' protesters show no sign of backing down
item.description: New Delhi's Supreme Court is expected to hear a petition on alleged vote rigging today, as thousands of protesters defy a security crackdown in the capital. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Minister says live streaming of US execution would be 'disgusting'
item.description: Labor frontbencher Murray Watt describes a proposed live streaming of a US execution as "absolutely disgusting" but stops short of committing to legislative change to prevent Australians from watching it. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Gould

item.title: Albury councillors hit pause on massive 29 per cent rate rise plan
item.description: Albury Ratepayers Association president Susan Keighran is leading the fight against Albury City Council's plan to impose an almost 30 per cent rate hike. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Ashlee Aldridge and Gaye Pattison

item.title: Refusing to yield momentum, ruthless Australia is perfectly set for victory
item.description: South Africa tried to wrestle back some control of the first Test, but Matt Renshaw again shone to put Australia in sight of victory. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Russell Jackson

item.title: Renewed mineral sands mine bid 'a turd in glitter', resident says
item.description: A planning expert has accused the Victorian government of manipulating its own system by reconsidering a critical minerals project it rejected in 2021. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Fiona Broom

item.title: Quick hits: Cummins goes big as Maddinson makes manic cameo
item.description: Pat Cummins's explosive knock pushes Australia clear, Keshav Maharaj produces some magic in his follow-through and Steve Smith doesn't join his teammates in the field. Here are the quick hits from day four of the first Test between Australia and South Africa. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: High-speed video reveals how honey bee stingers keep pumping venom after detachment
item.description: Australian scientists have used high-speed video to uncover the unique mechanism that allows a honey bee's stinger to continue to pump venom into its target even after it has separated from the bee's body. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Fijian bee genomics suggest 99% effective population decline since European colonization
item.description: The decline of pollinator species due to habitat loss and pesticide use over recent decades has been a global concern. Pollinators like bees and butterflies support both wild plants and agricultural food production, but many species are threatened and remain poorly studied. It's estimated that bees, in particular, pollinate between 78% and 94% of all plant species. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Study links environment and youth mental health
item.description: A new University of Canterbury-led study of almost 1 million young people in New Zealand shows the environments they live in may be linked to their mental health over time. Te Whare Wānanga o Waitaha | University of Canterbury (UC) researcher Dr. Lukáš Marek, in the School of Earth and Environment, says the findings add important evidence to conversations about how communities, neighborhoods and cities are planned. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Renshaw delivers again as Australia close on win
item.description: Australia close on statement victory over South Africa in Durban after Matt Renshaw's dream Test continues. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'Scary' dementia modelling shows how cases will surge by 2050
item.description: Alarming new dementia figures show an estimated 24.7 million people will be diagnosed with the disease each year by 2050 and women will be at higher risk than men. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Paige Cockburn

item.title: Is there a 'cliff-like' decline at menopause? Australian experts skeptical
item.description: A new international study suggests menopause-related changes to the body are sudden and "cliff-like", but Australian experts urge caution interpreting the results. Here's why. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lauren Roberts

item.title: Judge warns jurors as Russell Brand prepares for rape trial in London
item.description: British actor, comedian, and presenter Russell Brand has appeared in a London court for the start of his trial on historical sex offences. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Mazoe Ford

item.title: More part-time bosses and co-CEOs could keep women in leadership and narrow Australia’s pay gap
item.description: Uneven caring responsibilities combined with a lack of flexible work options have prevented women from staying in senior positions, research suggests Follow our Australia politics live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast More part-time bosses and “co-CEOs” could keep women in leadership and narrow Australia’s gender pay gap, the federal government’s Workplace Gender Equality Agency says. WGEA warned resistance to gender equality was growing and urged employers to make management more flexible to reduce the gender pay gap, where women earn $0.79… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Luca Ittimani
